Southern Morocco. The Sahara as a destination.

The Desert Journey

8 days · Marrakech · Atlas · Aït Ben Haddou · Fint Oasis · Erg Chigaga

8 days · Marrakech · Atlas · Aït Ben Haddou · Fint Oasis · Erg Chigaga

A route to discover some of the landscapes that make southern Morocco special, and to end the journey where everything falls silent: Erg Chigaga.

Marrakech, the High Atlas, kasbahs, oases and southern roads before we head into the Sahara for two nights.

A good choice for those who want to get to know Morocco and experience the desert in a single trip, without trying to see everything.

I want to do this route ↗
DAY 1 · Marrakech

Arrive and begin to look

Arrival in Marrakech and welcome.

A first day to rest, adjust to the rhythm of the country and begin discovering the city.

Medina, souks, a first tea and time to simply be.

DAY 2 · Marrakech

The red city

A day to get to know Marrakech at your own pace.

We can explore the medina, its markets and craftspeople, visit some of its most emblematic places or set aside time for a hammam, food experiences or simply strolling.

DAY 3 · Marrakech → Aït Ben Haddou

Crossing the Atlas

We leave Marrakech behind and cross the High Atlas.

The landscape changes little by little until we reach the south.

We will visit Aït Ben Haddou, one of the best-known kasbahs in Morocco, with time to walk its streets and take in the landscape.

DAY 4 · Aït Ben Haddou → Erg Chigaga

Towards the Sahara

We continue south through kasbahs, adobe villages, palm groves and increasingly arid landscapes.

After reaching M'Hamid, we leave the tarmac behind.

We climb into the 4x4s and begin crossing the tracks that lead to Erg Chigaga.

The horizon opens up. And the journey changes pace.

DAY 5 · Erg Chigaga

A day without hurry

Today there is nowhere to get to.

Sunrise among the dunes, breakfast, tea, walking on the sand, resting, learning about Saharan traditions or simply contemplating the landscape.

We can prepare bread baked under the sand, spend time with the team, enjoy henna or discover Saharan music as evening falls.

And when night comes: dinner, fire, stars and silence.

DAY 6 · Erg Chigaga → Fint Oasis

From the dunes to the oasis

We leave the desert behind and begin the journey back north.

The landscape transforms again. The sand gives way to oases, palm groves and kasbahs.

We arrive at the Fint Oasis, a small valley hidden among mountains. Time to walk, have a tea and rest.

DAY 7 · Fint Oasis → Marrakech

The last road

In the morning we can still enjoy the oasis before setting off for Marrakech.

We cross the High Atlas again as the landscape changes for the last time.

Arrival in Marrakech and time for a last dinner, a stroll or some shopping.

DAY 8 · See you soon

One last breakfast in Morocco

Breakfast and transfer to the airport.

Or, if your flights allow, we can adapt the end of the trip.

Your journey, your way

This route is a starting point.

We can adapt the route, the length, the accommodation and the experiences to your time, interests and way of travelling.
